ambient_events: A valve on the wall weeps a slow orange line of rust.
The dark presses in close in this dead little pocket.
Something small flees your light and vanishes behind the pipes.
description: A utility alcove at the crawlway's dead end — a niche of dead gauges, seized valves, and a workbench long since stripped for parts. Whatever crew maintained this place is decades gone, but they left their leavings scattered in the muck for anyone patient enough to sift.
name: Utility Alcove
